<!-- pr-reviewer: 0dd7eebc0dcbe30e3cc227dd26319c7089d6fa75 -->

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good
- Byte import shares the path import's laws: `checked_budget` is factored out of `ImportModel::within` (import_model.rs), so IGES/unknown extension refusal, STEP budget bounds and the non-STEP-budget refusal are one code path. `from_bytes` adds the `MAX_FILE_BYTES` cap and goes through `parse_model_graded_within` (same STEP facet budget guard as disk). No unwrap/expect/panic in the new non-test code; `usize`/`u64` conversion uses `try_from(..).unwrap_or(MAX)`.
- Everything Is a Command: picked files run as `CommandKind::OpenPicked`, models land via `finish_import` (undoable, same-name update). Project open uses the same `reset_for_open` as disk (behaviour unchanged).
- Layering ui -> app respected; `app` change is only in `commands/import_model.rs` and `geometry/import` (reads/writes the document). No new dependency, no Cargo/build.rs/.github/scripts/xtask/.cargo touched; no snapshot PNGs changed.
- Fit with main: #1438 `browser_files.rs` is edited minimally (Open model/project dropped from `refusal`, NEEDS_PICKER reworded, tests updated both ways); #1457 `file_drop.rs` is untouched and not duplicated (drop stays native-path based). Nothing dropped.
- Browser read limit (256 MiB) refused by name before read; input/closure held in one slot, not forgotten; failures go to the status line.
- Tests: `import_bytes.rs` (disk vs bytes parity, refusals by name), `file_pick_tests.rs` (7), theme_dir and browser_files tests. Decisions file present, `Refs #31`, `Changelog:` line present, not a process-file PR.

## Results (merged with main 3e18717a, on the self-hosted runner)
Run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43541685247 (success, head 0dd7eebc checked first). An earlier dispatch of mine failed only at the head check (I mistyped the SHA); no test ran in it.
- Quick gate on the merged tree: app suites ok (77s), ui suites ok (51s), 0 failed.
- Clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Windows-only readings: none in the diff (only `cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")`), so no local re-run owed.

## Not checked (say plainly)
- Not run in a real browser by me, and not compiled for wasm32 by me or by the Linux runner gate: the wasm32-only code (`file_pick::web`, the `#[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]` arms of `open_model_dialog`/`open_project_dialog`, `shell_web` hook) is not compiled by the Linux/native gate and was not compiled by me. The author reports `web/build-app-wasm.sh` passed on macOS and a hand check in Chrome, Brave and Safari (per PR comments); I did not run it in a browser.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- `state.rs` is 4451 lines (already far over ~400); net +12 here, with new code correctly put in `state_picked.rs`.
- `open_project_bytes` resets the old document before parsing, as the disk path does; a corrupt `.camproj` that is valid UTF-8 therefore clears the open document (only a non-text file is refused before the reset). The PR text says a refused project "changes nothing": true for non-text, not for bad JSON. Same as disk behaviour; worth a follow-up to load before reset.
- The import parses on the UI thread in the browser (no worker): a large STEP up to 256 MiB can freeze the tab for the duration; bounded by the facet budget but not by time.
- Note: the PR body says the cancelled picker never fires; the held hidden input stays in the DOM until the next pick (harmless).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
